concerns.text: FR-006 (verify existence of any technical term generated by the LLM against the codebase) has no explicit mapping in the plan. The plan’s Entity Extraction phase only mentions surface‑entity verification via git‑grep/AST, but does not address verification of technical‑intent terms.

FR-007 (exclude samples lacking a ground‑truth human documentation diff from statistical analysis) is not referenced in any phase of the plan. The plan’s Statistical Analysis phase assumes all samples are present but does not state a filtering step for missing diffs.
